faq.q: Is this medical care or physical therapy?
faq.a: No. Pilates is exercise. I don't diagnose or treat anything. I plan careful, injury-aware sessions and I'm happy to work alongside the advice of your doctor or physical therapist.

faq.q: Do I need to be cleared for exercise?
faq.a: Yes. If you have an injury, a recent surgery or a medical condition, please get the OK from your doctor or PT before we start. If you are not sure, ask them first.

faq.q: I've never done Pilates. Is that OK?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is taught step by step and adapted to you.

notReadyText: If you have a question before you commit, I'm happy to talk it through.
disclaimer: Pilates is exercise, not medical care. These sessions do not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Please check with your doctor or physical therapist before starting any exercise program, and stop any movement that causes sharp or unusual pain.
